support_tony: FYI we just got a P2 from Acme Corp — they hit a surge of 400/422 errors when their app calls our tool endpoint for price_lookup. Customer says it started after last weekend's runtime rollout.

devon: can you paste the raw request/response?

support_tony: pasted below (sanitized). they call via /v1/invoke -> tool: price_lookup, args mismatch on prod only. intermittent.

support_tony: ```
POST /v1/invoke
{
  \"tool\": \"price_lookup\",
  \"args\": {\"productId\": \"B17-33\"}
}
RESPONSE 422
{ \"error\": \"Tool schema validation failed: missing required field 'sku' for price_lookup_v2\" }
```

qa_ali: interesting — our golden evals picked this up in CI earlier today as flaky (test: eval/toolcall/price_lookup/golden_prompt). CI log shows schema mismatch sometimes selects v1 vs v2.

eng-liz: we have both price_lookup and price_lookup_v2 in the model routing table. v2 expects \"sku\" instead of \"productId\" (legacy mismatch). If the smart router switches variant, caller payload breaks.

devon: can we repro locally against the eval harness? share job id from CI?

qa_ali: CI job 43721. Snippet from harness: ```
EVAL: invoke_tool(\"price_lookup\", args={\"productId\":\"B17-33\"}) -> selector chose: price_lookup_v2 -> schema error
Trace: SchemaValidationError: Required \"sku\" not found
```

eng-liz: repro steps for me:
1) Checkout eval harness branch: git checkout fix/tool-selector-repro
2) Run: ./harness/run_eval.py --test price_lookup --seed 42 --route-policy smart_route
3) watch the tool selector choose v2 reproducibly when seed=42

devon: I ran the harness, confirmed. The selector's compatibility check treats v2 and v1 as compatible if both implement get_price, but we forgot to check param names.

sre_jen: customer impact: requests failing in prod -> some retries from their side cause elevated latency and some billing anomalies. we should rollback routing policy or pin to v1 for that tenant until fix.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-349 (priority P2) — linked to ticket 3489 in zendesk.

support_tony: assigned to me and eng-liz for immediate triage. customer on a call in 30m.

eng-liz: proposed short-term mitigations:
- add compatibility shim in router: translate productId -> sku for price_lookup_v2 when detected
- pin Acme to price_lookup (v1) via tenant routing override
- add CI regression test that fails if selector chooses variant with incompatible schema for same tool name

devon: long-term: update model onboarding checklist to include explicit arg schema compatibility checks and add unit that verifies field-level name matches. Also augment smart router to consult the tool schema registry before selection.

qa_ali: I'll add a golden-prompt CI test case that uses a mixed-bucket of prompts and asserts the selected tool accepts the payload. If mismatch occurs, fail CI early.

eng-liz: quick patch: I pushed draft PR (#5123) that adds a schema-compat check and a shim. PR description: \"router: enforce arg-key compatibility before committing variant; fallback to pinned variant or raise a controlled error.\"

devon: can you drop the debug logs that show the selector decision? we need to see which heuristics chose v2.

eng-liz: logs: ```
[2026-07-14T11:02:12Z] selector: candidates=[price_lookup, price_lookup_v2], scores=[0.62,0.88], compatibility_check: price_lookup_v2 -> FAIL (expected keys: [\"sku\"], provided keys: [\"productId\"]), decision: OVERRIDE -> pick price_lookup
```

support_tony: so after you added override it picks v1 for me. customer confirmed reduced errors in the call while on the bridge.

sre_jen: Actions:
- (eng-liz) promote PR 5123 to staging + run full eval suite (ETA 2h)
- (qa_ali) add regression in golden eval harness and CI (ETA 4h)
- (devon) follow up on model onboarding doc + create ticket for router schema registry (ETA EOD)
- (support_tony) notify customer and schedule patch window

devon: small note — CI still shows intermittent timeouts on the harness run when we force the compatibility check on. looks like we added a sync call that has a 10s default timeout. can someone check blocking calls in selector?

eng-liz: noted. I'll convert that to an async check and add a 1s non-blocking fallback then surface a soft-warning in console so CI doesn't time out.

qa_ali: I will rerun CI job 43721 after staging promotion and post results.

support_tony: thanks everyone. will update INC-2026-349 with customer notes. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: INC-2026-349 status -> in_progress (assigned: eng-liz, support_tony)

devon: postmortem items to add: improve eval coverage for tool schema regression, add golden prompts for v2 migration, and ensure backward compatibility or clear migration path.

eng-liz: quick follow-up: PR 5123 merged to staging at 2061124500, staging harness run started.

qa_ali: staging harness passed the new golden checks locally (seed 42) — pushing to CI.

support_tony: customer confirmed metrics normalized after pin (will keep monitoring). closing the urgent bridge once staging patch goes prod.

sre_jen: marking this as resolved for now but keeping the incident open until production rollout.

devon: thanks all. low friction but good catch — schema drift between tool variants will be a recurring class. need to bake more checks into onboarding and CI.

support_tony: closing notes added to ticket: \"Root cause: router variant selection allowed incompatible arg-key schema across tool variants. Remediations: router schema check, golden eval CI, tenant pinning option.\"

eng-liz: adding unit tests to ensure the selector's compatibility check returns deterministic results for same seed.

qa_ali: CI job 43721 re-run succeeded at 2061122605. adding link to PR and incident.

support_tony: :white_check_mark:
